topic: Myth: more features make a better app
caption:
Myth: “More features make a better app.” 🧩

Users don't open your app to admire the feature list. They open it to get one job done, fast.

Every extra feature adds design work, testing, maintenance and one more thing for users to learn. Too many, and the thing they actually came for gets buried.

The best apps do a few things really well, then grow based on what real users ask for.

Agree or disagree? Tell us in the comments. 👇
